# `quantum-time-transfer`

Scenario kind of the engine v0.39.0, family [Clocks, timing and holdover](../clocks-timing-and-holdover.md). Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service. Every label here is the engine's or the verification matrix's; a kind is MODELLED unless the matrix says otherwise (how a label is earned: the README's Evidence section).

## What it does

MODELLED trusted-quantum-timing chain: an end-to-end quantum (optical-lattice clock + entanglement/single-photon link) vs classical (CSAC + RF two-way) time-transfer budget, a reused timing protection level + a delay/replay-attack security FoM (1-P_md), a clock-anomaly detection probability + CUSUM latency, and the quantum-vs-classical trade as honest TradeEvidence with a representativeness + gaps-to-flight record. Illustrative public-source device/link params; models the class, no TRL/flight/certification claimed.

One run of `scenarios/quantum-time-transfer.toml` summarises as: quantum-time-transfer | quantum chain 1.233e-12s vs classical 5.292e-9s | PL 555.24 ns | security Pd 1.000 (Pfa 1e-3) | anomaly Pd 0.761 | trade quantum wins 2/2 | MODELLED
